title: STARTEX — Tuesday Morning in Greenville

fields.location: Tamarack Precision Components, Inc. — Corporate Office, Greenville, South Carolina
fields.load: Routine: 23 vendor payments in the Treasury Workstation queue, none above $250,000
fields.staffing: Normal business-day staffing. CFO in the air, Treasury Manager at the Spartanburg plant, CEO on site.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:30 Eastern on Tuesday, September 14, 2027, at Tamarack Precision Components headquarters in Greenville, South Carolina, and nothing unusual is expected today. CFO Marcus Delacroix-Hume boarded his flight from Greenville to Querétaro at 09:10. He lands at 12:50 Eastern, the flight has no Wi-Fi, and plant meetings follow. CEO Beatrix Aldgate-Moreno is in the building. Treasury Manager Gareth Lindqvist-Boyd is on a plant visit at Spartanburg and can only be reached by mobile between walk-throughs. The Treasury Workstation queue holds 23 routine vendor payments, international wires close at 15:00 Eastern, and the SOC managed service and both in-house analysts report a normal security posture.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read the card, ask each role to confirm its seat and to write down from the Tamarack directory the mobile numbers it would use today. Make sure the TPC-FIN-04 payment authorization policy is at every table.
fields.scenarioTitle: Escrow Echo — Deepfaked Executives, Wires & Public Trust

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline: who is away and how to reach them. Players should confirm their roles and directory contact numbers. Listen for whether they see that with the CFO in the air, approval of any payment at $1,000,000 or more falls to the Controller plus the CEO's delegate, and that callback goes to directory numbers or the executive assistant (TPC-FIN-04 sections 2 and 4).
